name: LK Technology
tagline: A night scene drawn in text characters, with pigeons to feed.
what: The landing page of LK Technology, a small studio for software, bots and AI.
points: The whole page is one night scene drawn in text characters: a crescent moon built from '#', dashed power lines on a pole, a skyline outlined in box characters with yellow '#' for lit windows, and a large flock of pigeons.
The pigeons are dense ASCII textures with two touches of colour, a green sheen at the neck and an orange eye, so they read as birds from a distance and as type up close.
Copy is cut to the name, 'Software, bots and AI.' and one hint, so the interaction does the selling.
Type: IBM Plex Mono throughout, light grey (#CDD8DB) on deep navy (#151F29). The name is set large and light at the bottom left beside a line-drawn bird logo.

Interaction: clicking anywhere scatters seed. Specks land along the ground line, the hint disappears and the flock comes down to feed, so the page works as a small toy before it reads as a company site.
Mobile: the scene is recomposed for a tall screen with fewer, larger birds, and the hint changes from 'Click' to 'Tap to scatter seed' and moves above the name.

flow.caption: Before any click: the flock circles in a loose ring between the wires and the rooftops, five pigeons stand on the ground and 'Click to scatter seed' sits at the bottom right.
After the first click the hint is gone and a few seed specks have landed beside the pigeons on the ground.
More clicks spread seed further along the ground, and the ring of flying birds starts to drop towards it.
The flock comes down to feed: birds land with wings raised and crowd the ground line where the seed fell.
